title: Roadmap to the Platinum
note: Order the stages as listed; finish every missable item before the story finale (Stage 3).

stages.name: Prologue → Chapter 1
stages.description: Play through the opening and Chapter 1, collecting the early mission trophies as they come.

stages.name: Chapters 2–3
stages.description: Keep the story moving through Chapters 2 and 3, grabbing story trophies and the early one-off events.
missable: In The Beginning… (cocktail on Ocean Beach) is a one-off side beat; do it while you are near the boardwalk.

stages.name: Heists, Partners & Strangers
stages.description: The most missable block: stranger strands, partner activities and the finale. Do these before the story's end.
missable: The stranger strand finals (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) lock after the story — finish all 8 strands before the finale.
Fair Game (Bret's unique animal) must be hunted before his strand closes.
Hot Together and Retail Therapy need your partner in free roam; do them while the partner is available.
Gunslinger, Capital Offense and Let's Go Bowling are best done before post-game changes.
Personal Best and Actions Speak Louder are tied to story events that pass.

stages.name: Activities & Minigames
stages.description: Clear the activity and minigame trophies: stunts, races, drone races, shooting gallery, arcade and odd encounters.
missable: Catch Me If You Can and Sneakthief are easiest in the early game before security is everywhere.
Challenging Tank, Bad Luck and The Truth Is Out There rely on encounters that can be skipped if you finish quickly.

stages.name: Collectibles & Completion
stages.description: Collectibles, challenges, businesses and the 100% push.
missable: A Classic Blitz Play (armored truck) is a random traffic event; keep an eye out for trucks while driving.

stages.name: Platinum & 100%
stages.description: Reach 100% completion, then collect the platinum.
